reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, so I am already looking. The lab report for the batch and the money-back guarantee make a first box at $24.99 an easy risk to take.
objection: It is made in China and I only have the page's word that the lab report is real. Also two capsules every day is a chore I may drop after a week.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page did not match the batch number on the box, or the lab could not be found, I would pass.
